commands.name: Check ADB version
commands.description: Show the installed ADB version.

commands.name: List Android devices
commands.description: List connected Android devices and their details.

commands.name: Target a specific device
commands.description: Run a command on one device when multiple devices are connected.

commands.name: Start ADB server
commands.description: Start the ADB server process.

commands.name: Kill ADB server
commands.description: Stop the ADB server. Useful when a device shows offline or unauthorized.

commands.name: Open Android shell
commands.description: Open an interactive shell on the connected Android device.

commands.name: Enable wireless ADB (TCP/IP)
commands.description: Restart ADB on the device in TCP/IP mode. Device must be connected by USB first.

commands.name: Connect over Wi-Fi
commands.description: Connect to a device over the network.

commands.name: Pair wireless debugging (Android 11+)
commands.description: Pair with a device using the pairing code from Wireless debugging settings.

commands.name: Disconnect network device
commands.description: Disconnect from all network devices, or a specific one if given.

commands.name: Install APK
commands.description: Install an APK on a connected Android device.

commands.name: Install test/debug APK
commands.description: Reinstall (-r), allow test APKs (-t) and allow version downgrade (-d).

commands.name: Install split APKs
commands.description: Install an app made of multiple split APKs.

commands.name: Uninstall app
commands.description: Remove an app from the device.

commands.name: Follow Android logs
commands.description: Stream device log messages to the terminal.

commands.name: Filter logs by tag and level
commands.description: Show only logs of a given tag at or above a level (V, D, I, W, E, F).

commands.name: Filter logs by app process
commands.description: Show logs only from one running app process.

commands.name: Clear log buffer
commands.description: Clear all existing log buffers.

commands.name: Save logs to file
commands.description: Dump current logs and exit, saving them to a file.

commands.name: Copy file to device
commands.description: Copy a file or folder from the computer to the device.

commands.name: Copy file from device
commands.description: Copy a file or folder from the device to the computer.

commands.name: List device files
commands.description: List files in a device directory.

commands.name: Access debug app private data
commands.description: Run a command as the app user. Works only for debuggable apps, no root needed.
examples: adb shell run-as com.example.app ls databases
adb exec-out run-as com.example.app cat databases/app.db > app.db

commands.name: List installed packages
commands.description: List package names installed on the device.
examples: adb shell pm list packages | grep example

commands.name: Get APK path of a package
commands.description: Show the APK file location on the device.

commands.name: Clear app data
commands.description: Delete all app data and cache, like a fresh install.

commands.name: Grant runtime permission
commands.description: Grant a runtime permission to an app without using the UI.
examples: adb shell pm grant com.example.app android.permission.CAMERA

commands.name: Revoke runtime permission
commands.description: Revoke a runtime permission from an app.
examples: adb shell pm revoke com.example.app android.permission.CAMERA

commands.name: Launch an activity
commands.description: Start a specific activity.

commands.name: Launch app by package
commands.description: Launch an app's main screen without knowing the activity name.

commands.name: Test deep link
commands.description: Open a deep link or app link to test intent filters.
examples: adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "myapp://home/item/42" com.example.app

commands.name: Force stop app
commands.description: Kill the app and all its processes.

commands.name: Send broadcast
commands.description: Send a broadcast intent to test receivers.
examples: adb shell am broadcast -a android.intent.action.BOOT_COMPLETED -p com.example.app

commands.name: Show current activity
commands.command: adb shell dumpsys activity activities | grep mResumedActivity
commands.description: Find which activity is currently in the foreground.
examples: adb shell dumpsys activity activities | grep mResumedActivity

commands.name: Check app memory usage
commands.description: Show memory details of an app. Good for finding leaks.

commands.name: Check frame rendering stats
commands.description: Show jank and frame timing stats for UI performance.
examples: adb shell dumpsys gfxinfo com.example.app framestats

commands.name: Show package info
commands.description: Show version, permissions, install time and more for an app.
examples: adb shell dumpsys package com.example.app | grep versionName

commands.name: Battery info and simulation
commands.description: Show battery state. Can also fake levels for testing.
examples: adb shell dumpsys battery set level 15

commands.name: Read device properties
commands.description: Read system properties such as Android version, model and SDK level.

commands.name: Take screenshot
commands.description: Capture the device screen and save it on the computer.

commands.name: Record screen
commands.description: Record the device screen. Stop with Ctrl+C, then pull the file.

commands.name: Type text on device
commands.description: Send text input to the focused field. Use %s for spaces.

commands.name: Tap or swipe on screen
commands.description: Simulate a tap or swipe at screen coordinates.

commands.name: Send key event
commands.description: Press a hardware or system key such as Back, Home or Power.

commands.name: Change screen size
commands.description: Override screen resolution to test layouts. Reset with 'wm size reset'.

commands.name: Change screen density
commands.description: Override screen DPI to test different density buckets. Reset with 'wm density reset'.

commands.name: Toggle dark mode
commands.command: adb shell cmd uimode night yes
commands.description: Switch system night mode on or off to test themes.
examples: adb shell cmd uimode night yes
adb shell cmd uimode night no

commands.name: Disable animations
commands.command: adb shell settings put global window_animation_scale 0
commands.description: Turn off animations for stable UI tests. Repeat for transition and animator scale.
examples: adb shell settings put global transition_animation_scale 0
adb shell settings put global animator_duration_scale 0

commands.name: Toggle Wi-Fi or mobile data
commands.description: Enable or disable Wi-Fi and mobile data to test offline behaviour.

commands.name: Forward port to device
commands.description: Forward a computer port to a device port.

commands.name: Reverse port to computer
commands.description: Let the device reach a server running on your computer via localhost. Handy for local API testing.

commands.name: Run Monkey stress test
commands.description: Send random UI events to find crashes.

commands.name: Run instrumentation tests
commands.description: Run instrumented tests directly from the shell.

commands.name: Generate bug report
commands.description: Collect full device logs and system state into a zip file.

commands.name: List running processes
commands.description: Show running processes. Use pidof to get a single app PID.

commands.name: Reboot device
commands.description: Restart the connected device.

commands.name: Reboot to bootloader
commands.description: Restart into bootloader (fastboot) mode.

commands.name: Reboot to recovery
commands.description: Restart into recovery mode.
